name: CodeSnippet
description: Syntax-highlighted code block with a language picker, optional line numbers, and a copy button.

aria-label.description: Accessible name for the snippet region.

allowCopy.description: Show the copy button; keep on for reusable code.

variant.description: Layout variant: inline token, single line, or multi-line window.

maxLines.description: Clamp height to this many lines; longer code scrolls. 0 disables the clamp.

onCopy.description: Fires after the code is copied to the clipboard.

criteria.note: 2026-05-28 — Promoted from alpha: Example + ForcedColors stories present; Storybook axe gate enabled. 2026-07-08 — captured Default and Example accessibility-tree snapshots plus a real Playwright forced-colors snapshot; stable remains blocked until the Figma URL points at a real numeric node id. 2026-07-10 — Figma component set built (Molecules, node 1161-2809: Inline/Single/Multi variants, DT token bindings); promoted to stable with RhythmguardPage as production consumer.

deprecation.reason: Superseded by Snippet (copyable commands; the $ prompt is never copied), Code (inline code, sm/md/lg) and CodeBlock (multi-line code with header, callout rows and terminal theme), 2026-10-25, react 0.1.38. CodeSnippet folded three jobs into one variant prop (inline/single/multi) with a SplitButton copy menu, show-more truncation and component-local Prism colours that never followed the theme tokens. Migrated consumer: the Rhythmguard case study (install steps now a terminal CodeBlock).
